citations.narrative:
During a review of facility records, the following non-compliance involving handling of animals was observed. On 8/22/25,
a pig was undergoing a procedure under anesthesia as part of a research study. The animal, while still under anesthesia,
was strapped onto the table but was unstrapped to lower the table and transfer the animal to a transport cart. The animal
fell off the lift table approximately 3 feet to the floor. Following the incident, the pig was observed with bruising behind the
ear and along the spine between the shoulder blades and exhibited mild lameness on the right hind leg. The pig was
treated with pain medications for several days and recovered without incident. The facility instituted corrective actions
including securing all patients throughout the entire process, having 2 technicians with large sized animals, a new lift table
and hoist, and padded recovery rooms.
Failure to handle animals in a careful manner may result in physical harm and unnecessary discomfort.
Handling of animals must be done as carefully as possible in a manner that does not cause trauma, physical harm, or
unnecessary discomfort.
Correct by: Corrected at the time of inspection. Continue to handle animals in a careful manner from 7/23/26 forward.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the IACUC representatives.
